activation_rule: Neighbors remain dormant until the no-control core passes every non-neighborhood official threshold and every stricter bull, bear, chop, role, sleeve, concentration, A5 coverage, pooled-IC, and fold-IC gate. They can adjudicate stability but cannot rescue any earlier failure.
materialization_rule: Change only the declared executable constant, preregister its exact source/config/risk identities, and run serially before reading the result; restore and verify the base source exactly afterward.

neighbors.hypothesis: A shorter baseline adapts compression to newer volatility.
A longer baseline tests whether compression survives slower volatility context.
Six days of pre-shock compression tests faster setup recognition.
Eight days of compression tests setup persistence.
A stricter ceiling admits only clear volatility contraction.
A looser ceiling tests whether the edge is threshold-local.
Earlier saturation reduces domination by extreme shocks.
Later saturation preserves more shock-magnitude differentiation.

selection_prohibition: Do not add, remove, recenter, or choose among neighbors after any neighborhood result is observed.
